description: Migration script for transforming visualization parameters from 'directed_force' to 'graph_chart' and vice versa in the Superset project, involving database schema updates and JSON parameter modifications.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: SQLAlchemy ORM model representing the 'slices' table with columns for id, viz_type, and params.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Converts 'directed_force' visualization slices to 'graph_chart' by updating parameters and visualization type.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Reverts 'graph_chart' slices back to 'directed_force' by restoring original parameters and visualization type.
